hotspots.title: Trump administration pushes governmentwide NDA
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is proposing a sweeping new nondisclosure agreement (NDA) for all federal employees to prevent leaks of sensitive information. This move has sparked significant controversy and debate over free speech and government transparency.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its implications for government transparency, potential suppression of whistleblowers, and the broader impact on democratic norms.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and internal rifts
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces growing internal rifts within his party, La Libertad Avanza, and declining public support. Recent polls show a significant drop in his approval ratings, and internal disputes threaten his legislative agenda.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the high stakes of Milei's economic reforms, the potential for political instability, and the intense public reaction to his policies.

hotspots.title: Meloni-Villarruel rift deepens over Tedeum snub
hotspots.blurb: The rift between Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and her coalition partner, Deputy PM Matteo Villarruel, has intensified following Villarruel's snub at the Tedeum ceremony. This highlights ongoing tensions within Italy's right-wing coalition.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the potential instability within Italy's governing coalition and the broader implications for European politics.

hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its implications for the stability of Meloni's government and the broader political landscape in Italy.

hotspots.title: PiS internal feud over Supreme Court appointment
hotspots.blurb: Poland's ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party is embroiled in an internal feud following President Karol Nawrocki's appointment of a new Supreme Court Chief Justice, Zbigniew Kapiński, against the party leader Jarosław Kaczyński's wishes.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high stakes of judicial independence in Poland, the potential for political instability, and the intense public reaction to the appointment.
